subject: english
question:
Choose the right meaning of the idiom 'take with a grain of salt' in the sentence:

You should take his claims with a grain of salt.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Accept with doubt**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"take with a grain of salt"** means to view something with skepticism or to accept it cautiously. (संदेह या सावधानी के साथ कुछ स्वीकार करना) • **Example:** When reading online reviews, it's always wise to take them with a grain of salt. • **Accept with doubt** means to believe something partially while keeping some reservations or questions about its accuracy. (संदेह के साथ स्वीकार करना) • **Example:** She accepted his explanation with doubt, knowing his habit of exaggeration. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Accept with doubt**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Believe fully** (पूरी तरह से विश्वास करना): To accept something as entirely true without any doubt. • **Example:** He believes fully in his team's ability to win the championship. • **Ignore it completely** (पूरी तरह से अनदेखा करना): To disregard something entirely without giving it any attention. • **Example:** She ignored the criticism completely and continued with her work. • **Add salt to it** (इसमें नमक डालें): This is a literal interpretation of the phrase and not its actual meaning. • **Example:** He asked if he could add salt to his soup to enhance the flavor. 65:Tadd, The correct answer is: **2) Act spontaneously without planning**.
